raw.head: PersonX is angry at another
raw.literal: Sohan is aggressive. Sohan is angry at another.
raw.narrative: Sohan was enraged when she saw her little sister playing with her favorite toy without asking. She immediately went over and snatched the toy away while yelling at her sister.
dialogue: How dare you! That's my favorite toy! You can't just take it without asking!
I'm sorry, I didn't know it was your favorite. I was just playing with it.
Well, now you know. So give it back!
Here, you can have it back. I'm sorry for taking it without asking.
